title: Align before Attend: Aligning Visual and Textual Features for Multimodal Hateful Content Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a multimodal framework for hateful content detection. While it notes that memes often target religion (providing an example involving a woman in a hijab) and discusses social stability, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics themselves as primary subjects of inquiry.
